exercises.explanationUz:
3-MODUL MUQOVASI - 9 va 10-UNITLAR.


⚠ 'MAN'S WORKS':

  = inson ijodi, inson yaratgan
  narsalar.
  ⚠ 'man' bu yerda = insoniyat
  (eski uslub).
  ⚠ "Man's" - egalik apostrofi.


⚠ 'A WORLD OF WONDERS':

  = mo''jizalar dunyosi.
  ⚠ 'a wonder' = mo''jiza.
  ⚠ 'the Seven Wonders of the World'
  = dunyoning yetti mo''jizasi.


⚠ 'STICK TO THE RULES!':

  = qoidalarga rioya qiling!
  ⚠ 'to stick to' = ... ga rioya
  qilmoq, ... dan chetlanmaslik.
  ⚠ 'to stick' odatda = yopishtirmoq.


⚠ 'A LANDMARK':

  = mashhur joy, diqqatga sazovor
  inshoot (Tower Bridge kabi).


⚠ 'AN INVENTOR':

  = ixtirochi.
  ⚠ 'to invent' = ixtiro qilmoq;
  'an invention' = ixtiro.


⚠ 'A SAFETY LEAFLET':

  = xavfsizlik varaqasi.


⚠ 'A WARNING':

  = ogohlantirish.
  ⚠ 'to warn' = ogohlantirmoq.


⚠ SURATLAR:

  Tower Bridge - Londondagi mashhur
  ko'prik (1894).
  Terracotta Army - Xitoyda topilgan
  sopol askarlar (miloddan oldingi
  III asr).

exercises.instructionEn: Module 3, Units 9-12: Learn how to ... / Practise ...
exercises.explanationUz:
3-MODUL MUQOVASI - 11 va 12-UNITLAR
VA MODUL MAQSADLARI.


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  LEARN HOW TO (muloqot)          ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  • ma'lumot so'rash
  • ijobiy va salbiy rozi bo'lish
    ('So do I' / 'Neither do I')
  • muammolarga yechim taklif qilish
  • taklif so'rash va taklif qilish


╔══════════════════════════════════╗
║  PRACTISE (grammatika)           ║
╚══════════════════════════════════╝

  • MAJHUL NISBAT (the passive) -
    'The bridge WAS BUILT in 1894.'
  • too/enough - 'too hot', 'hot
    enough'
  • BUYRUQ MAYLI (the imperative) -
    'Don't touch!'
  • might/could/have to/had to/
    must(n't) - modal fe'llar
  • can/be allowed to - ruxsat
  • 2-TUR ShART GAPLARI - 'If I were
    you, I would ...'
  • NISBIY OLMOShLAR (relatives) -
    who, which, that, where
  • some/any/no


⚠ 'OUR PRECIOUS PLANET':

  = bizning qimmatli sayyoramiz.
  ⚠ 'precious' = qimmatli, aziz.
  ⚠ 11-unit - ekologiya.


⚠ 'HOLIDAYS WITH A DIFFERENCE':

  = o'zgacha ta'tillar (odatdagidan
  farqli).
  ⚠ 'with a difference' = o'zgacha,
  g'ayrioddiy.


⚠ 'ENDANGERED SPECIES':

  = yo'qolib ketish xavfi ostidagi
  turlar.
  ⚠ 'species' - birlik va ko'plik
  BIR XIL.
  ⚠ O'qilishi /ˈspiːʃiːz/.


⚠ 'THE RAINFOREST':

  = tropik o'rmon.


⚠ 'POLLUTION':

  = ifloslanish.
  ⚠ 'to pollute' = ifloslantirmoq.


⚠ 'A HOLIDAY RESORT':

  = dam olish maskani, kurort.
